Name: System Monitor Pro
Description: See your PC's CPU, GPU, memory, disk and network on the keys: a number, a bar and a two-minute graph for each. Windows only. Not affiliated with Ulanzi.

Actions.Name: CPU usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how much of the processor is in use, in percent.

Actions.Name: GPU usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how much of a graphics card is in use, in percent. NVIDIA or AMD.

Actions.Name: Video memory usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how much video memory is in use, in percent.

Actions.Name: Memory usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how much memory is in use, in percent.

Actions.Name: Ping
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the round trip to a server.

Actions.Name: Packet loss
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the share of pings that got no answer.

Actions.Name: Disk usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how full a drive is, in percent.

Localization.lhm.offline: LibreHardwareMonitor does not answer. It is only needed for an AMD card, or for a PC with no thermal zone. Open it as administrator, then turn on Options > Remote Web Server > Run. It loads a driver that some game anti-cheats block, so close it before such a game.
Localization.nvidia.missing: nvidia-smi was not found, so there is no NVIDIA card to read.
Localization.nvidia.offline: nvidia-smi stopped answering. It is started again shortly.
Localization.windows.missing: This PC has no thermal zone for Windows to read.
Localization.windows.offline: The thermal zone could not be read.
Localization.node.offline: The processor, memory or drive could not be read.
Localization.lhm.unconfigured: The LibreHardwareMonitor address is turned off in the plugin's environment variables.
